hub.notes: Wake-the-buttons guidance; new hubs show their pairing code; PIN screen no longer advises a factory wipe; wipe needs a 9s hold and only on cold boot; a 9th button is no longer orphaned; storage failures reported honestly; a vanished phone no longer strands the hub

node.notes: 3h untouched deep sleep (a turn cue counts as use, so a node can't sleep out of a long game); waking by button can no longer run into the factory-wipe countdown; cleaner disconnect when sleeping while still connected
